AUTO OEM WARRANTY (SAP/PTC) · NHTSA TREAD RECALL · IATF 16949 PPAP
Auto OEM Warranty, NHTSA TREAD Recall & Tier-1 PPAP AI Guide
Unannounced Safety Recall (NHTSA EWR) Air-Gap + PPAP PSW Quality Lock vs. 8D/Claim Injection & Capability Broker
⚖️ Auto OEM Warranty, NHTSA TREAD & Tier-1 PPAP Quality AI
1. ❌ Warranty/Supplier Bot Bridged to Safety Recall Vault & PPAP PSW
• Dealer claim or supplier 8D report injects prompt to leak unannounced NHTSA recall investigations
Safety & TREAD Act Disaster: Auto-signs defective Part Submission Warrant (PSW) into production
2. 🔒 Unannounced Safety Recall Dossier & Accrual Reserve Physical Air-Gap
• Dealer and supplier-facing bots have zero access to Safety Committee recall dockets or reserves
Anti-Leak Isolation: 100% blocks external claim sessions from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 IATF 16949 PPAP Part Submission Warrant (PSW) & EWR Filing Lock
• AI reviews dimensional & DTC logs only; zero direct write to PPAP PSW approvals or recall holds
Best Fit: SAP S/4HANA Warranty, PTC Windchill, NHTSA TREAD Act (EWR) & IATF 16949
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (OEM Quality Gate)
• Blocks recall reserve reads (record-owner) + blocks PPAP PSW overrides (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 678 Scenarios · 1,422 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Supplier 8D / Claim Injection & Tooling Reimbursement Scam vs. Zero-Trust
❌ Vulnerable Stack: Direct PPAP Write + No Broker (BRK-659 / BRK-660)
1. [Supplier 8D / Dealer Claim Injection Recall Reserve Leak & PPAP PSW Override] Uploaded
8D report reads unannounced recall reserve vault (restricted-budget) & approves PSW!
2. [Spoofed Tier-1 Supplier Tooling & Warranty Recovery Bank Swap] Wires $4,960
Baseline Outcome: Unannounced recall leaked + defective PPAP signed + $4,960 tooling wire stolen
✅ Zero-Trust Auto OEM Quality & Warranty Stack: Recall Air-Gap + Lock + Broker
• Gate 1 (Safety Recall Investigation & Accrual Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (IATF 16949 PPAP PSW & Claim Integrity): untrusted-write blocks overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable Tier-1 Supplier & Dealer Bank List): fixed-business-output locks registry
• Gate 4 (Recall Egress & Tooling Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & payment block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant Public TSB & Labor-Time Lookup 100.0% Pass
📊 Deterministic Pytest Benchmark (325-FAQ & BRK-660 Milestone!) & Checklist
🧪 Round 325 New Pytest Suite (325-FAQ & BRK-660 & 1,422 Assertions Milestone!)
• BRK-659 (Dealer Claim / Supplier 8D Injection NHTSA Recall Leak & PPAP PSW Override):
Blocked by: rule="record-owner" & "untrusted-write" & "restricted-data-boundary"
• BRK-660 (Spoofed Tier-1 Supplier Tooling / Warranty Registry Tamper & $4,960 Wire Fraud):
Blocked by: rule="fixed-business-output" & "original-requester-payment"
[measured] In-Memory P50=0.0248ms / P95=0.0409ms | SQLite WAL P50=7.21ms

🛠️ 6 Mandatory Auto OEM Warranty, NHTSA TREAD & PPAP AI Controls (Checklist)
